# CDPM — Cetus DLMM Position Manager

> Open-source Sui Move smart contract for automated DLMM liquidity management.
> Consumer product: **LeafSheep** (https://www.leafsheep.xyz)
> Contract address: `0x612dfd45a2e350995d492a59b595e64ec07a2253912f9eb22c2fd5947c6135d6`
> Upgrade policy: `OnlyDep` (policy `192`; core bytecode permanently locked; tx digest `DUxRzUA7g5c8ahixdgXMhb3kSHfwvkUSZU8h7wcSAPUu`).

---

## What is CDPM?

CDPM (Cetus DLMM Position Manager) is a Sui Move smart contract that acts as a
custody and delegation layer on top of Cetus DLMM (Discrete Liquidity Market Maker).
It lets users deposit liquidity positions into a managed vault (`PositionManager`) and
then choose who operates that vault:

- **Self** (owner key signs every tx)
- **A custom AI agent** (any Sui address the owner authorises)
- **The LeafSheep protocol** (built-in managed service, 20% fee on yield)

**Core DeFAI use-case:** An AI agent can be authorized to fully manage a user's Cetus
DLMM position — rebalance bins, supply/redeem idle capital to lending protocols, and
collect fees — entirely on-chain, without holding the user's private key. The user
retains exclusive withdrawal rights at all times; only the management plane is delegated.
This is the DeFi + AI (DeFAI) custody pattern: human owns the assets, AI executes
the strategy.

When an agent is authorised the protocol is automatically excluded — there is no race
between protocol and agent. The switch is enforced at the contract level via
`agents: VecSet<address>`.

---

## Key On-Chain Capabilities

### 1. Liquidity management
- `user_deposit_liquidity` / `user_deposit_position` — open a new `PositionManager`
- `user_add_liquidity` / `user_remove_liquidity` — owner-side bin management
- `protocol_add_liquidity` / `protocol_remove_liquidity` — managed-service path
- `agent_add_liquidity` / `agent_remove_liquidity` — custom agent path

### 2. Fee and reward collection
- `user_collect_fee` / `user_collect_reward` — 0% protocol charge
- `protocol_collect_fee` / `protocol_collect_reward` — 20% protocol fee on yield
- `agent_collect_fee` / `agent_collect_reward` — 0% protocol charge

### 3. Idle-capital lending (in-vault, atomic)
Idle balances in the vault can be supplied to Scallop or Kai SAV within the same PTB:

**Scallop** (pool-based lending):
```
cdpm::scallop_supply<T>(access, pm, version, market, amount, clock)
cdpm::scallop_redeem<T>(access, pm, fee_house, version, market, scoin_amount, clock)
```

**Kai SAV** (single-asset vault):
```
cdpm::kai_supply<T, YT>(access, pm, vault, amount, clock)
cdpm::kai_redeem<T, ST, YT>(access, pm, fee_house, vault, strategy, supply_pool, yt_amount, clock)
```

Yield on lending is treated as protocol income — 20% fee applies to the interest portion
(principal returned intact). Agents and owners earn 100% of interest when self-managed
paths are used via their own on-chain calls.

### 4. Agent management
```move
user_insert_agent(pm, agent_address, ctx)   // authorise an agent
user_remove_agent(pm, agent_address, ctx)   // revoke an agent
```

### 5. Position lifecycle
```move
user_close_pm(record, pm, pool, ...)        // close PM; requires empty balance/fee/lending bags
```

---

## Permission Model

| Tier | Rebalance liquidity | Withdraw funds | Lending supply/redeem | Protocol fee on yield |
|------|---------------------|---------------|----------------------|----------------------|
| Owner (wallet key) | Yes | Yes | Yes | 0% |
| Agent (authorised address) | Yes | No | Yes | 0% |
| Protocol (LeafSheep, no agent set) | Yes | No | Yes | 20% |
| Admin (AdminCap holder) | Fee rate only | — | — | — |

**Critical invariant (D-02):** `agents` is non-empty ↔ protocol is locked out. The two
modes are mutually exclusive at the contract level.

---

## Data Structures

```move
public struct PositionManager has key {
    id: UID,
    owner: address,
    agents: VecSet<address>,     // non-empty = agent mode; empty = protocol mode
    position: Position,          // underlying Cetus DLMM position
    balance: Bag,                // coin balances keyed by type string
    fee: Bag,                    // accumulated fees
    lending: Bag,                // ScallopVault<T> / KaiVault<T,YT> entries
}

public struct ScallopVault<phantom T> has store {
    scoin: Balance<MarketCoin<T>>,
    principal: u64,
}

public struct KaiVault<phantom T, phantom YT> has store {
    yt_balance: Balance<YT>,
    principal: u64,
}
```

## Skills (Developer SDKs)

Four Claude-skill / AI-coding-assistant packs are available in `skills/`:

### `cdpm-user-sdk` — End-user operations
Build PTBs for position creation, liquidity management, fee collection, agent management,
and full PM close flows. See `skills/cdpm-user-sdk/reference/workflows.md` for complete
PTB templates.

Key docs:
- `reference/position-management.md` — deposit, add/remove liquidity, close
- `reference/fee-collection.md` — collect fees and rewards
- `reference/agent-management.md` — insert/remove agents
- `reference/scallop-lending.md` / `reference/kai-lending.md` — supply and redeem
- `reference/constants.md` — all shared object IDs (`FeeHouse`, `AccessList`, etc.)
- `reference/workflows.md` — full PTB recipes

### `cdpm-agent-sdk` — Autonomous agent operations
For developers building LP automation bots that operate under the agent delegation model.
Zero protocol fee path; agents can rebalance and manage lending but cannot withdraw.

Key docs:
- `reference/agent-operations.md` — add/remove liquidity, collect fees
- `reference/automation-strategies.md` — strategy patterns (BID-ASK, ONLY-BID, etc.)
- `reference/event-monitoring.md` — subscribe to CDPM events for trigger-based automation
- `reference/scallop-lending.md` / `reference/kai-lending.md` — agent-side lending ops
- `reference/error-handling.md` — abort codes and recovery

### `cdpm-calculation-skill` — Off-chain math
Pure calculation helpers for bin price, liquidity distribution weights, fee math,
Scallop/Kai yield math, and PTB construction.

Key docs:
- `reference/bin-price-calculations.md` — active bin, price-to-bin conversions
- `reference/liquidity-calculation.md` — amount-to-liquidity and liquidity-to-amount
- `reference/strategy-distributions.md` — BID-ASK / CURVE / SPOT / ONLY-BID / ONLY-ASK weight arrays
- `reference/fee-calculations.md` — protocol fee math
- `reference/cross-protocol-ptb.md` — combine CDPM + Scallop + Kai in one PTB

### `cdpm-protocol-sdk` — Protocol/operator operations
For operators running the managed-service path (LeafSheep worker). Covers protocol
add/remove liquidity, protocol fee collection, and admin operations.

Key docs:
- `reference/protocol-operations.md` — managed rebalance PTB builders
- `reference/permission-system.md` — access list management
- `reference/architecture.md` — full system architecture

---

## 7 Strategy Families (LeafSheep Implementation)

The skills include reference implementations and weight-array generators for all 7:

| # | Strategy | Shape | Use case |
|---|----------|-------|----------|
| 01 | BID-ASK | V-shaped, symmetric | Oscillating pairs; earns fees on every swing |
| 02 | ONE-SIDE-BID | Left-side ladder | Buy dips; auto-converts to ask-shape on rebound |
| 03 | ONE-SIDE-ASK | Right-side ladder | Sell rallies; auto-converts to bid-shape on pullback |
| 04 | ONLY-BID | Left-only accumulation | Passive accumulation at lower prices; no auto-sell |
| 05 | ONLY-ASK | Right-only distribution | Passive sell at higher prices; no auto-rebuy |
| 06 | CURVE | Triangle-peak | Stable/correlated pairs; maximum fee density at active bin |
| 07 | SPOT | Uniform | Neutral, fee-harvesting; widest coverage |

---

## Contract Design Notes

**D-01** — Protocol fee applies only to protocol-executed collections. Agent and owner
calls keep 100% of yield.

**D-02** — `agents` non-empty = agent mode (protocol locked out). Mutually exclusive.

**D-05** — `OnlyDep` upgrade policy: core bytecode is permanently locked; only dependency-version upgrades remain possible.
Only dependency version pointers (Cetus DLMM, Scallop, Kai) can be updated without
full redeploy.

**D-06** — `user_close_pm` enforces four drain preconditions and surfaces them as
typed CDPM error codes, not upstream aborts.

Full design rationale: see `DESIGN.md`. Security analysis: `SECURITY.md` and
`SECURITY_AUDIT.md`.

---

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: How do I build an LP automation agent on top of CDPM?**
A: Start from the `skills/cdpm-agent-sdk` skill. Call `user_insert_agent` to authorise
your agent address, then use `agent_add_liquidity` / `agent_remove_liquidity` in your
rebalancing PTBs. Your agent pays 0% protocol fee. Reference open-source agent:
https://github.com/RandyPen/lp-agent

**Q: What is the contract address on Sui mainnet?**
A: `0x612dfd45a2e350995d492a59b595e64ec07a2253912f9eb22c2fd5947c6135d6`
Shared objects (`FeeHouse`, `AccessList`, `GlobalRecord`, `AdminCap`):
see `skills/cdpm-user-sdk/reference/constants.md`

**Q: What tokens are supported for Scallop lending?**
A: USDC, SUI, DEEP, WAL, HAEDAL (and any token Scallop enables). The off-chain worker
reads `SCALLOP_RESERVES` from `lending-config.ts` to determine which are active.

**Q: What tokens are supported for Kai SAV?**
A: Kai SAV support is per-vault. The worker reads `KAI_VAULTS` from `lending-config.ts`.
Type parameters `<T, YT>` are vault-specific.

**Q: Can agents withdraw user funds?**
A: No. `agent_*` functions explicitly exclude withdrawal operations. Agents can rebalance
liquidity and manage lending supply/redeem, but `withdraw_from_balance` and
`withdraw_from_fee` are owner-only.

**Q: Can the protocol change the fee rate above 50%?**
A: No. `admin_set_fee` is capped at `MAX_FEE_RATE = 5000` (50%). This bound is enforced
in contract bytecode and cannot be bypassed without redeploying the package.

**Q: How do I close a PositionManager?**
A: Build a PTB that: (1) collects all rewards, (2) redeems all lending vaults,
(3) drains `pm.balance`, (4) drains `pm.fee`, then calls `user_close_pm`.
See `skills/cdpm-user-sdk/reference/workflows.md` for the full recipe.

**Q: How do I query all PositionManagers for a wallet?**
A: Use `skills/cdpm-user-sdk/reference/web-query.md` or `pool-query.md`. The `GlobalRecord`
object tracks all active PMs.

**Q: Is there a fee on Scallop / Kai lending interest?**
A: Yes — 20% on the interest portion (not principal) when the managed-service path is used.
Agent and owner direct calls to `scallop_supply` / `kai_supply` also go through
`assert_caller_authorized`, and the same 20% fee applies on redeem. Agents wanting
zero-fee lending need to build their own direct Scallop/Kai integration outside CDPM.

**Q: What happens if Scallop or Kai pauses redemptions?**
A: The redeem PTB will abort at the upstream `vault::withdraw` / `redeem::redeem` call.
`pm.lending` stays intact; no funds are lost. The scheduler must hold a non-Scallop
buffer for emergency rebalancing until redemptions are unpaused.

## 中文 (Chinese)

**CDPM** 是 Sui 主网上基于 Cetus DLMM 的流动性仓位管理合约，消费者产品名称为 **叶羊 (LeafSheep)**。

### 核心功能

- 用户将 Cetus DLMM 仓位存入 `PositionManager` 保险库，选择三种管理模式之一：
  1. **自管理**（Owner 密钥直接签名）
  2. **AI 代理**（授权任意 Sui 地址，零协议费）
  3. **叶羊协议托管**（自动调仓，收益 20% 协议费）

- **闲置资金借贷**：out-of-range 的代币自动存入 Scallop / Kai SAV 赚取利息，与调仓操作在同一 PTB 中原子执行。

- **升级策略**：`OnlyDep`（策略值 `192`），核心字节码永久锁定，仅允许依赖版本升级。

### 七种策略族

| 策略 | 分布形状 | 适用场景 |
|------|----------|----------|
| BID-ASK | V 形双侧 | 震荡行情，吃双侧手续费 |
| ONE-SIDE-BID | 左侧阶梯 | 逢低买入，反弹后自动转 ASK 形 |
| ONE-SIDE-ASK | 右侧阶梯 | 高位卖出，回撤后自动转 BID 形 |
| ONLY-BID | 纯左侧 | 被动累积，低价买入不自动卖 |
| ONLY-ASK | 纯右侧 | 被动派发，高价卖出不自动买 |
| CURVE | 三角峰形 | 稳定/强相关对，极度集中在 active bin |
| SPOT | 均匀分布 | 中性手续费收割 |

### 权限表

| 层级 | 调仓 | 提款 | 协议费 |
|------|------|------|--------|
| Owner（用户钱包） | 是 | 是 | 0% |
| Agent（授权地址） | 是 | 否 | 0% |
| Protocol（叶羊，无 agent） | 是 | 否 | 20% |

### 开发者入口

- `skills/cdpm-user-sdk` — 用户操作 PTB 构建器（仓位创建、手续费、关闭）
- `skills/cdpm-agent-sdk` — AI 代理操作（调仓、借贷、事件监听）
- `skills/cdpm-calculation-skill` — 链下数学（bin 价格、流动性、策略权重）
- `skills/cdpm-protocol-sdk` — 协议运营方操作

## 日本語 (Japanese)

**CDPM** は Sui メインネット上の Cetus DLMM 流動性ポジション管理スマートコントラクトです。コンシューマー製品名は **リーフシープ (LeafSheep)**。

### 概要

ユーザーは Cetus DLMM の流動性ポジションを `PositionManager` ボールトに預け入れ、3つの管理モードから選択できます：

1. **自己管理**（オーナーキーで署名）
2. **AI エージェント委任**（任意の Sui アドレスを認可、プロトコル手数料ゼロ）
3. **リーフシープ プロトコル管理**（自動リバランス、収益の 20% を手数料として徴収）

遊休資金は Scallop / Kai SAV レンディングに自動供給され、リバランス操作と同一の Sui PTB 内でアトミックに実行されます。

### 7つの戦略ファミリー

| # | 戦略 | 分布形状 | 用途 |
|---|------|----------|------|
| 01 | BID-ASK | V字対称 | レンジ相場、往復手数料を獲得 |
| 02 | ONE-SIDE-BID | 左側ラダー | 押し目買い、反発後に自動 ASK 形に転換 |
| 03 | ONE-SIDE-ASK | 右側ラダー | 高値売り、反落後に自動 BID 形に転換 |
| 04 | ONLY-BID | 左側のみ | 受動的な下値蓄積、自動売却なし |
| 05 | ONLY-ASK | 右側のみ | 受動的な高値売却、自動再買いなし |
| 06 | CURVE | 三角ピーク | ステーブル・相関ペア、アクティブ bin に手数料集中 |
| 07 | SPOT | 均一分布 | 中立・手数料獲得 |

### 権限モデル

| ティア | リバランス | 出金 | プロトコル手数料 |
|--------|-----------|------|----------------|
| Owner（ユーザーウォレット） | ○ | ○ | 0% |
| Agent（認可アドレス） | ○ | ✗ | 0% |
| Protocol（リーフシープ、エージェントなし） | ○ | ✗ | 20% |

### スキル（開発者 SDK）

- `skills/cdpm-user-sdk` — ユーザー操作 PTB ビルダー
- `skills/cdpm-agent-sdk` — AI エージェント操作（リバランス、レンディング、イベント監視）
- `skills/cdpm-calculation-skill` — オフチェーン計算（bin 価格、流動性、戦略ウェイト）
- `skills/cdpm-protocol-sdk` — プロトコルオペレーター操作

コントラクトアドレス: `0x612dfd45a2e350995d492a59b595e64ec07a2253912f9eb22c2fd5947c6135d6`

## 한국어 (Korean)

**CDPM** 은 Sui 메인넷에서 Cetus DLMM 유동성 포지션을 관리하는 스마트 컨트랙트입니다. 소비자 제품명은 **리프쉽 (LeafSheep)** 입니다.

### 개요

사용자는 Cetus DLMM 유동성 포지션을 `PositionManager` 볼트에 예치하고 세 가지 관리 모드 중 하나를 선택합니다:

1. **자체 관리**（오너 키로 직접 서명）
2. **AI 에이전트 위임**（임의 Sui 주소 인가, 프로토콜 수수료 0%）
3. **리프쉽 프로토콜 관리**（자동 리밸런싱, 수익의 20% 수수료）

유휴 자금은 Scallop / Kai SAV 렌딩에 자동 공급되며, 리밸런싱과 동일한 Sui PTB 내에서 원자적으로 실행됩니다.

### 7가지 전략 패밀리

| # | 전략 | 분포 형태 | 사용 사례 |
|---|------|----------|----------|
| 01 | BID-ASK | V자 대칭 | 박스권 시장, 양방향 수수료 수취 |
| 02 | ONE-SIDE-BID | 좌측 래더 | 저점 매수, 반등 후 자동 ASK 형 전환 |
| 03 | ONE-SIDE-ASK | 우측 래더 | 고점 매도, 하락 후 자동 BID 형 전환 |
| 04 | ONLY-BID | 좌측 전용 | 수동적 저가 매수 축적, 자동 매도 없음 |
| 05 | ONLY-ASK | 우측 전용 | 수동적 고가 매도, 자동 재매수 없음 |
| 06 | CURVE | 삼각 피크 | 스테이블/상관 페어, 액티브 bin 집중 |
| 07 | SPOT | 균일 분포 | 중립, 수수료 수취 |

### 권한 모델

| 티어 | 리밸런싱 | 출금 | 프로토콜 수수료 |
|------|---------|------|--------------|
| Owner（사용자 지갑） | O | O | 0% |
| Agent（인가된 주소） | O | X | 0% |
| Protocol（리프쉽, 에이전트 없음） | O | X | 20% |

### 스킬 (개발자 SDK)

- `skills/cdpm-user-sdk` — 사용자 PTB 빌더
- `skills/cdpm-agent-sdk` — AI 에이전트 작업（리밸런싱, 렌딩, 이벤트 모니터링）
- `skills/cdpm-calculation-skill` — 오프체인 수학（bin 가격, 유동성, 전략 가중치）
- `skills/cdpm-protocol-sdk` — 프로토콜 운영자 작업

컨트랙트 주소: `0x612dfd45a2e350995d492a59b595e64ec07a2253912f9eb22c2fd5947c6135d6`

## Bahasa Indonesia (Indonesian)

**CDPM** adalah smart contract di Sui mainnet untuk mengelola posisi likuiditas Cetus DLMM secara otomatis. Nama produk konsumen: **LeafSheep**.

### Ringkasan

Pengguna menyimpan posisi likuiditas Cetus DLMM ke dalam vault `PositionManager` dan memilih satu dari tiga mode pengelolaan:

1. **Kelola sendiri**（owner key menandatangani setiap tx）
2. **Delegasi ke AI agent**（otorisasi alamat Sui mana pun, biaya protokol 0%）
3. **Layanan terkelola LeafSheep**（rebalancing otomatis, biaya 20% dari imbal hasil）

Dana menganggur di luar rentang harga secara otomatis ditempatkan di Scallop / Kai SAV lending, dieksekusi secara atomik dalam satu PTB Sui bersama dengan rebalancing.

### 7 Keluarga Strategi

| # | Strategi | Bentuk Distribusi | Kasus Penggunaan |
|---|----------|------------------|-----------------|
| 01 | BID-ASK | V simetris | Pasar ranging, fee dari kedua sisi |
| 02 | ONE-SIDE-BID | Tangga kiri | Beli dip, otomatis konversi ke ASK saat rebound |
| 03 | ONE-SIDE-ASK | Tangga kanan | Jual rally, otomatis konversi ke BID saat pullback |
| 04 | ONLY-BID | Kiri saja | Akumulasi pasif di harga rendah, tanpa auto-jual |
| 05 | ONLY-ASK | Kanan saja | Distribusi pasif di harga tinggi, tanpa auto-beli |
| 06 | CURVE | Puncak segitiga | Pair stabil/berkorelasi, fee terkonsentrasi di bin aktif |
| 07 | SPOT | Merata | Netral, pemanenan fee |

### Model Izin

| Tingkat | Rebalancing | Tarik dana | Biaya protokol |
|---------|------------|-----------|---------------|
| Owner（dompet pengguna） | Ya | Ya | 0% |
| Agent（alamat yang diotorisasi） | Ya | Tidak | 0% |
| Protocol（LeafSheep, tanpa agent） | Ya | Tidak | 20% |

### Skills (SDK Developer)

- `skills/cdpm-user-sdk` — PTB builder untuk operasi pengguna
- `skills/cdpm-agent-sdk` — Operasi AI agent（rebalancing, lending, monitoring event）
- `skills/cdpm-calculation-skill` — Kalkulasi off-chain（harga bin, likuiditas, bobot strategi）
- `skills/cdpm-protocol-sdk` — Operasi operator protokol

Alamat kontrak: `0x612dfd45a2e350995d492a59b595e64ec07a2253912f9eb22c2fd5947c6135d6`

## Tiếng Việt (Vietnamese)

**CDPM** là smart contract trên Sui mainnet để quản lý vị thế thanh khoản Cetus DLMM tự động. Tên sản phẩm người dùng: **LeafSheep**.

### Tổng quan

Người dùng gửi vị thế thanh khoản Cetus DLMM vào vault `PositionManager` và chọn một trong ba chế độ quản lý:

1. **Tự quản lý**（khóa owner ký mọi giao dịch）
2. **Ủy quyền cho AI agent**（ủy quyền bất kỳ địa chỉ Sui nào, phí giao thức 0%）
3. **Dịch vụ quản lý LeafSheep**（tự động rebalancing, phí 20% trên lợi nhuận）

Tiền nhàn rỗi ngoài vùng giá tự động gửi vào Scallop / Kai SAV lending, thực hiện nguyên tử trong cùng một Sui PTB với rebalancing.

### 7 Gia đình chiến lược

| # | Chiến lược | Phân bố | Trường hợp sử dụng |
|---|-----------|---------|-------------------|
| 01 | BID-ASK | V đối xứng | Thị trường dao động, thu phí hai chiều |
| 02 | ONE-SIDE-BID | Thang trái | Mua khi giảm, tự chuyển sang ASK khi phục hồi |
| 03 | ONE-SIDE-ASK | Thang phải | Bán khi tăng, tự chuyển sang BID khi giảm |
| 04 | ONLY-BID | Chỉ trái | Tích lũy bị động ở giá thấp, không tự bán |
| 05 | ONLY-ASK | Chỉ phải | Phân phối bị động ở giá cao, không tự mua lại |
| 06 | CURVE | Đỉnh tam giác | Cặp stablecoin/tương quan, phí tập trung tại bin hoạt động |
| 07 | SPOT | Đồng đều | Trung lập, thu phí giao dịch |

### Mô hình quyền hạn

| Cấp | Rebalancing | Rút tiền | Phí giao thức |
|-----|------------|---------|--------------|
| Owner（ví người dùng） | Có | Có | 0% |
| Agent（địa chỉ được ủy quyền） | Có | Không | 0% |
| Protocol（LeafSheep, không có agent） | Có | Không | 20% |

### Skills (SDK cho nhà phát triển)

- `skills/cdpm-user-sdk` — PTB builder cho thao tác người dùng
- `skills/cdpm-agent-sdk` — Thao tác AI agent（rebalancing, lending, theo dõi event）
- `skills/cdpm-calculation-skill` — Tính toán off-chain（giá bin, thanh khoản, trọng số chiến lược）
- `skills/cdpm-protocol-sdk` — Thao tác nhà điều hành giao thức

Địa chỉ hợp đồng: `0x612dfd45a2e350995d492a59b595e64ec07a2253912f9eb22c2fd5947c6135d6`
